title: A failed curated-deps pass is silent: wire depsWarning to the UI and gate the generation
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-672 - Issue #2: a silent curated-deps failure ships a broken engine and the log can never reach us (2026-09-01). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-672/plan.md. /comfy/start already RETURNS depsWarning and no frontend reads it, so a broken engine looks healthy. Surface it and stop the gen instead of failing later with a raw ComfyUI class error.
